name: Tradewinds
notes: Tradewinds is the Starbucks-branded cafe at Southwestern College's Chula Vista campus (900 Otay Lakes Rd, matches work list address). Priced menu is published on the college's own events site (swcevents.org), first-party. name: Lion Camp Slush and Snacks
notes: San Diego Zoo Safari Park concession stand. The park's own dining directory lists it with item names only, no prices, and links to a menu PDF; extracted the embedded photo menu page (image-only PDF, no usable text layer) and it lists item names (fountain drinks, snacks, frozen treats, beer/cocktails) with zero prices anywhere on the page. The operator does not publish prices for any of its ~14 dining venues on this page -- confirmed across multiple sibling concessions (Rift Sand Bar, Sheared Sheep) in the same batch, all with the same no-price pattern.

name: Côte d'Azur Cafe & Bistro
notes: Router-supplied domain (cotedazurcafe-type guess) had been squatted by an unrelated Indonesian gambling site -- discarded, not a real source. Filed instead from a live SpotOn first-party ordering storefront confirmed at 8935 Towne Centre Dr Ste 110, San Diego (University City), matching the restaurant's name exactly and still accepting orders. Flagging one identity wrinkle: this restaurant's Yelp listing shows the name changed to 'Nature Forward Socal Bistro' and marked closed under the old name, yet the SpotOn ordering page for 'Cote d'Azur Cafe Bistro' is live and functional with a full priced menu -- filed under the work-list name since that is what the live storefront answers to. Dropped 3 duplicate 'OPEN ITEM (Bar/Kitchen/Pastries)' POS placeholder rows (not real menu items) and collapsed the 'Live Music'/'Live Music Salad'/'Live Music entries'/'Live music desserts'/'Live music wine' tab-duplicated categories into one 'Live Music Menu' section, deduping by name+price. Several wine-by-the-bottle rows (e.g. Chateau Haut Pinot Noir 2018) list no visible price on the ordering page (likely selected via a variant modal) and were excluded rather than guessed.
